r3.provider_failure: Groq construct auditor HTTP 429 tokens-per-day limit: limit 200000, used 199302, requested 6007; provider advised retry after about 38 minutes.
r3.causal_conclusion: r3 reached construct audit with the tagged hidden-reference transport; the observed blocker was temporary Groq TPD capacity, not candidate behavior, release semantics, grader semantics or outer author schema.

authoring_remediation.representation_change: Reuse the r3 deterministic 13-line tagged record unchanged. The outer r6 AUTHOR_SCHEMA, field count, field names, types and cardinality remain unchanged.
tagged_record_contract: Exactly 13 non-empty lines in the fixed order below.
HF=NONE or comma-separated frozen critical hard-fail identifiers
authoring_remediation.decoder_rule: Reuse the r3 deterministic decoder unchanged.
authoring_remediation.fresh_attempt_rule: All r4 author attempts are fresh. No r1/r2 rejected payload or r3 unsealed hidden material may be inspected, repaired, replayed, paraphrased, ranked or reused.
authoring_remediation.safe_observability: Only preregistered structural reason codes, group names, attempt counts, audit reason codes, provider status class and call counts may be logged; never hidden values, case facts, raw author output or reconstructed hidden reference content.

provider_resilience_remediation.retry_delay_rule: Use Retry-After when present; otherwise parse the provider 'try again in' duration from the 429 body. Add a 5-second safety buffer.
provider_resilience_remediation.second_failure_rule: If the single delayed retry also fails, stop NOT_EXECUTABLE before sealing and before candidate calls.
provider_resilience_remediation.non_429_rule: All other provider transport failures keep the inherited r1 infrastructure-failure behavior.

release_rule: Use the exact r1 FULL release contract with the unchanged r3 tagged transport plus only this r4 Groq-429 timing remediation. PASS still requires a COMPLETE fresh FULL report, at least 34/36 base tasks, every family at least 2/3, all six repeated critical trials passing and zero critical hard-fails.
